title.zh: 伊朗称三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷，美方护航仍在，美财政部扩大制裁
title.en: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort, as Treasury widens sanctions

summary.zh: 伊朗方面称，三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷后起火，事发时美军正在护航。与此同时，美国财政部加大制裁力度，意在切断德黑兰的金融命脉。这一事态加剧了市场对全球石油运输要道安全的担忧。
summary.en: Iran said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, despite a U.S. escort presence. The U.S. Treasury widened sanctions aimed at cutting off Tehran's financial lifelines, heightening concern over the key oil chokepoint.

reports.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort, as Treasury widens sanctions

title.zh: 英伟达重新任命黄仁勋为CEO
title.en: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

summary.zh: 英伟达董事会重新任命黄仁勋为首席执行官，相关消息迅速引发科技界高度关注。具体背景及公司后续安排尚待披露。
summary.en: Nvidia’s board has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, according to company and media reports. The move drew intense attention across the tech industry, with further details still unclear.

reports.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
Trump sealed deal for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again
Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO

title.zh: Anthropic推出Claude Ship，允许AI代理审查、修复并批准代码变更
title.en: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes

summary.zh: Anthropic推出Claude Ship开发者工具，让AI代理审查、修复并批准代码变更，以处理日常审批瓶颈。随着AI生成代码激增，该工具旨在减少开发流程中的阻塞。
summary.en: Anthropic has launched Claude Ship, developer tools that let AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes. The company aims to ease routine approval bottlenecks as AI-generated code piles up.

reports.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

title.zh: COP31失败揭示分裂的世界
title.en: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

summary.zh: 石油生产国利益、美国抵制以及资金争端可能使气候谈判受挫。此次失败反映出全球气候治理中的深刻分歧。
summary.en: The failure of COP31 climate talks, amid oil producers' interests, a US boycott and finance disputes, may have torpedoed the negotiations. It highlights deep divisions in global climate governance.

reports.title: What failure of COP31 reveals about a divided world

title.zh: 亚马逊以75亿美元收购Decart的AI优化技术，为销售Trainium芯片做准备
title.en: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips

summary.zh: 亚马逊据悉以75亿美元收购Decart的AI优化技术及研究团队，以强化其AI能力。此举正值亚马逊准备销售Trainium芯片之际。
summary.en: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal. The move comes as Amazon prepares to sell its Trainium chips.

reports.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips

title.zh: GLM-5.4：借助首个循环Transformer迈向通用编程
title.en: GLM-5.4: Toward generalized coding with our first loop transformer

summary.zh: Z.ai发布GLM-5.4，称这是其首个循环Transformer模型，目标是推进通用编程能力。该模型在开发者社区引发关注。
summary.en: Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, describing it as its first loop transformer and a step toward generalized coding. The model drew attention from developers.

reports.title: GLM-5.4: Toward generalized coding with our first loop transformer

title.zh: 北约秘书长誓言应对太空威胁 此前有俄核卫星报道
title.en: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports

summary.zh: 德国媒体报道称，俄罗斯计划在未来数周发射携带核弹头的卫星。北约秘书长承诺防御太空威胁。
summary.en: German media reported that Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead in the coming weeks. NATO's chief vowed to defend against space threats.

reports.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports

title.zh: 黄仁勋丑闻核心公司Megaspeed或将被列入美国黑名单
title.en: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist

summary.zh: 处于黄仁勋丑闻中心的Megaspeed似乎将被列入美国黑名单。除非获得联邦政府特别许可，该公司将被禁止与美国企业做生意。
summary.en: Megaspeed, at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a U.S. blacklist. Unless it obtains a special federal license, it would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies.

reports.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

title.zh: AI数据中心给混乱的联合国气候谈判再添难题
title.en: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks

summary.zh: 在土耳其安塔利亚闭幕的COP31气候谈判混乱且难言满意。全球电气化与高耗能AI数据中心同时扩张，使代表们面临新的能源挑战。
summary.en: AI data centers added another complication to the chaotic COP31 climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, which ended without a satisfying outcome. Delegates faced the challenge of electrifying the global economy while data-center power demand surges.

reports.title: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks

title.zh: 苹果上架九年后将我的开源应用从欧盟App Store下架
title.en: Apple removed my open-source app from EU App Stores after 9 years

summary.zh: 开发者称，苹果将其开源笔记应用 FsNotes 从欧盟区 App Store 下架，该应用已上架九年。此事在 Hacker News 引发热议，讨论聚焦苹果对开源项目与欧盟侧载规则的执行尺度。
summary.en: The developer of FsNotes, an open-source note-taking app available for nine years, says Apple removed it from EU App Stores. The case, widely discussed on Hacker News, raises questions about how Apple applies EU sideloading rules to small open-source projects.

reports.title: Apple removed my open-source app from EU App Stores after 9 years

title.zh: “达里奥在夸大风险，好让开源模型被禁、自己保持控制权”
title.en: "Dario is hyping the dangers so OSS models are illegal and he stays in control"

summary.zh: 图灵奖得主 Yann LeCun 在 X 上指责 Anthropic CEO 达里奥·阿莫代夸大 AI 风险，意在推动开源模型被立法禁止，从而维持自身对 AI 的控制。该言论在技术社区引发激烈争论。
summary.en: Yann LeCun accused Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei of exaggerating AI risks so that open-source models would be outlawed and he could keep control. The post sparked intense debate on Hacker News over AI safety advocacy and open-weight models.

reports.title: "Dario is hyping the dangers so OSS models are illegal and he stays in control"

title.zh: Ladybird 浏览器进入 alpha 阶段
title.en: Ladybird is now in alpha

summary.zh: 独立浏览器项目 Ladybird 发布首个 alpha 版本，其自研引擎开始面向公众测试。该项目目标是打造不依赖 Chromium 或 Gecko 的独立浏览器，消息在开发者社区广受关注。
summary.en: The independent Ladybird browser project released its first alpha, opening its self-built engine to public testing. It aims to offer a browser not based on Chromium or Gecko; the announcement drew wide attention among developers.

reports.title: Ladybird is now in alpha

title.zh: 分析师：黄仁勋“大到不能解雇”，英伟达治理结构受关注
title.en: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts

summary.zh: 黄仁勋的回归凸显出英伟达对创始人的高度依赖，其董事会监督与公司治理机制因此受到审视。分析师认为，黄仁勋的地位已“大到不能解雇”，这引发了对继任安排与权力制衡的讨论。
summary.en: Jensen Huang's return underscored Nvidia's deep reliance on its founder, prompting scrutiny of board oversight and corporate governance. Analysts say he is effectively "too big to fire," raising questions about succession and checks on his authority.

reports.title: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts
黄仁勋回归“比肥皂剧精彩”！华尔街争论他是否“大到不能解雇”、英伟达董事会是否向资本低头 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 独家：哈西娜拟于12月16日乘国有航空公司航班返回孟加拉国
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Sheikh Hasina seeks to return to Bangladesh on December 16 on state carrier - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社独家消息称，孟加拉国前总理谢赫·哈西娜计划于12月16日搭乘国有航空公司航班回国。此举可能对该国当前政治局势产生重大影响。
summary.en: Former Bangladeshi prime minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home on December 16 aboard the state carrier, Reuters reported exclusively. The move could significantly affect the country's political situation.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Sheikh Hasina seeks to return to Bangladesh on December 16 on state carrier - Reuters

title.zh: 澳大利亚网络安全法案或令科技巨头面临数十亿美元罚款
title.en: Big Tech could face billions of dollars in fines under Australian internet safety bill - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，澳大利亚拟议的网络安全法案将对大型科技公司施加更严格义务，违规者可能面临高达数十亿美元的罚款。该法案旨在强化平台责任与用户保护。
summary.en: Australia's proposed internet safety bill could expose major tech companies to fines of billions of dollars, Reuters reported. The legislation aims to tighten platform obligations and user protections.

reports.title: Big Tech could face billions of dollars in fines under Australian internet safety bill - Reuters

title.zh: A股三大股指齐涨，创业板早盘一度涨4%，算力硬件股集体反弹
title.en: A-Shares Rise Across the Board; ChiNext Jumps 4% Intraday as Computing Hardware Stocks Rebound

summary.zh: A股三大指数同步上涨，创业板指早盘一度涨4%，算力硬件板块集体大幅反弹。港股方面，恒生科技指数高开2%后回落，权重科网股多数走低。
summary.en: China's three main A-share indexes rose together, with ChiNext up as much as 4% early on as computing hardware stocks rebounded sharply. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Tech Index opened 2% higher before fading, with heavyweight internet names mostly lower.

reports.title: A股三大股指齐涨，创业板早盘一度涨4%，算力硬件集体大反弹，恒科指早盘高开2%后回落，权重科网股多走低 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 罗兴亚种族灭绝裁决后 英国制裁缅甸军方高层
title.en: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling

summary.zh: 英国与其他多国承认国际法院关于缅甸实施种族灭绝的裁决。英国随后制裁缅甸军方高层。
summary.en: The UK and several other nations recognised an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide against the Rohingya. The UK then sanctioned top Myanmar military leaders.

reports.title: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling

title.zh: 俄舰在利比亚遇袭说明乌克兰战争外溢
title.en: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war

summary.zh: 乌克兰在利比亚港口击沉一艘俄罗斯战舰，使战争风险升级。分析称这显示乌克兰战争的影响正在扩散。
summary.en: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian warship at a Libyan port raises the stakes of the war. Analysts say it shows the conflict's effects are spreading beyond Ukraine.

reports.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
PODCAST: Huang reinstated, Ukraine hits Russian ship, Black Friday AI (Updated) - Reuters

title.zh: 应 Arm 要求，该网站将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日停止运营
title.en: Per Arm's request, this site will be discontinued on 4 December 2026 :(

summary.zh: 一个托管 Arm 指令集参考资料的第三方网站宣布，应 Arm 公司要求将于 2026 年 12 月 4 日停止运营。该站长期被开发者用于快速查阅资料，关闭消息引发社区惋惜。
summary.en: A third-party site hosting Arm architecture reference material says it will shut down on December 4, 2026 at Arm's request. Developers who relied on it for quick lookups reacted with disappointment.

reports.title: Per Arm's request, this site will be discontinued on 4 December 2026 :(

title.zh: 谷歌搜索 AI 模式现可调用 Drive 与 Wallet，提供更个性化回答
title.en: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses

summary.zh: 谷歌将 AI 模式中的“个人智能”功能扩展至 Drive、Wallet 与 Gemini 应用，可基于用户个人数据给出更个性化的回答。此举依托其生态内既有用户数据，也引发对隐私边界的关注。
summary.en: Google's AI Mode in Search can now draw on Drive and Wallet, as well as the Gemini app, to give more personalized answers. The move leverages user data already inside Google's ecosystem and raises questions about privacy boundaries.

reports.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses

title.zh: 俄勒冈与弗吉尼亚州就 Grok 色情深度伪造起诉 SpaceX
title.en: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes

summary.zh: 俄勒冈州与弗吉尼亚州总检察长分别对 SpaceX 提起诉讼，指控其未采取行业标准防护措施，并对 X 平台及 Grok 功能的安全性作虚假宣传，导致未经同意的色情深度伪造内容传播。
summary.en: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia filed separate lawsuits accusing SpaceX of violating consumer protection laws by skipping industry-standard safeguards and misrepresenting the safety of X and Grok amid nonconsensual sexual deepfakes.

reports.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes

title.zh: 乐施会：以色列袭击使加沙沦为“有毒废土”
title.en: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says

summary.zh: 乐施会报告称，以色列的军事行动导致加沙几乎全境出现可能的污染迹象。报告警告当地环境与公共卫生面临严重且持久的人道风险。
summary.en: Oxfam said Israel's military campaign has left signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza. The aid group warned of severe and lasting environmental and public health risks.

reports.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says

title.zh: XNU Linux：在 Linux 上运行完整的 OS X 图形用户空间
title.en: XNU Linux: Full OS X GUI Userspace on Linux

summary.zh: 开发者发布开源项目 XNU Linux，尝试在 Linux 系统上运行完整的 macOS（OS X）图形用户空间，使苹果桌面环境可脱离苹果硬件使用。该项目在 Hacker News 上引发热议，获得约 600 分与 240 余条评论。
summary.en: An open-source project called XNU Linux aims to run the full OS X graphical userspace on top of Linux, letting Apple's desktop environment run off Apple hardware. It drew roughly 600 points and 240 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: XNU Linux: Full OS X GUI Userspace on Linux

title.zh: 用互联网档案馆冷门影像搭建的免费另类电视网
title.en: Free alternative TV network built from the Internet Archive's forgotten videos

summary.zh: 网站 Spelunkr.tv 利用互联网档案馆中被人遗忘的旧视频，搭建了一个免费的另类电视频道式流媒体服务。该创意在 Hacker News 上走红，获得逾 960 分和 160 多条评论。
summary.en: Spelunkr.tv offers a free, channel-style streaming service assembled from forgotten videos in the Internet Archive. The project drew strong attention on Hacker News, with over 960 points and more than 160 comments.

reports.title: Free alternative TV network built from the Internet Archive's forgotten videos

title.zh: 证明黎曼猜想，是一场踩中IPO节点的意外吗
title.en: Proving the Riemann Hypothesis: An Accident Timed to an IPO?

summary.zh: 财新发文讨论黎曼猜想证明相关进展与其时间点同IPO节点之间的关联。文章追问这一数学突破的时机是否只是巧合。
summary.en: Caixin examines whether reported progress on the Riemann Hypothesis coincides suspiciously with an IPO timeline. The article asks whether the timing of the mathematical breakthrough is merely coincidence.

reports.title: 证明黎曼猜想，是一场踩中IPO节点的意外吗 - 财新

title.zh: 美墨哥斯达黎加牙买加获2031年女足世界杯主办权，英国将办2035年赛事
title.en: US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Jamaica awarded 2031 Women's World Cup, UK to host 2035 edition - Reuters

summary.zh: 国际足联决定由美国、墨西哥、哥斯达黎加和牙买加联合主办2031年女足世界杯，英国获得2035年主办权。赛事扩军背景下，主办权分配体现女足全球化布局。
summary.en: The United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will co-host the 2031 Women's World Cup, while the UK was awarded the 2035 edition, Reuters reported. The decisions reflect the tournament's global expansion.

reports.title: US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Jamaica awarded 2031 Women's World Cup, UK to host 2035 edition - Reuters

title.zh: Kagi 推出邮件服务 Kagi Mail 公开测试版
title.en: Kagi Mail (public beta)

summary.zh: 付费搜索引擎 Kagi 宣布其邮件产品 Kagi Mail 进入公开测试，主打隐私友好与无广告体验。消息在 Hacker News 上获得约 380 分及近 290 条讨论。
summary.en: Paid search engine Kagi has opened its email product, Kagi Mail, to public beta, emphasizing privacy and an ad-free experience. The announcement reached about 380 points and nearly 290 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: Kagi Mail (public beta)

title.zh: 黄仁勋回归英伟达推动美股大涨，美债收益率走高
title.en: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，黄仁勋重返英伟达相关活动提振科技股情绪，带动华尔街主要股指大幅上涨。与此同时，美国国债收益率上升。
summary.en: Wall Street's main indexes rallied as Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia-related appearances lifted tech sentiment, Reuters reported. US Treasury yields rose at the same time.

reports.title: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise - Reuters

title.zh: 北卡罗来纳州胜选令民主党拿下1990年代初以来最大众议院优势
title.en: North Carolina win gives Democrats biggest US House majority since early 1990s - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，民主党在北卡罗来纳州的一场选举中获胜，使其在众议院的席位优势达到上世纪90年代初以来最大。这一结果可能影响后续立法议程走向。
summary.en: A Democratic win in North Carolina gives the party its largest US House majority since the early 1990s, Reuters reported. The result could shape the legislative agenda ahead.

reports.title: North Carolina win gives Democrats biggest US House majority since early 1990s - Reuters

title.zh: 科伦系迎80后新帅，185亿“输液大王”扶子“上位”
title.en: Kelun Group Hands Reins to Post-80s Successor as 'Infusion King' Passes Baton to Son

summary.zh: 界面新闻报道德科伦系企业交接班，一位80后新任掌门人走上前台。市值约185亿元的“输液大王”将帅位交予其子。
summary.en: Jiemian reports a generational leadership change at Kelun Group, with a successor born in the 1980s taking charge. The 'infusion king,' valued at about 18.5 billion yuan, has handed control to his son.

reports.title: 科伦系迎80后新帅，185亿“输液大王”扶子“上位” - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 五折外卖，谁来买单？
title.en: Half-Price Food Delivery: Who Foots the Bill?

summary.zh: 界面新闻关注外卖平台大打折扣战的成本归属问题。报道探讨低价补贴由平台、商家还是消费者最终承担。
summary.en: Jiemian examines who ultimately bears the cost of deep discounts in China's food delivery market. The report asks whether platforms, merchants or consumers absorb the subsidies behind half-price meals.

reports.title: 五折外卖，谁来买单？ - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 人工智能，一个新词的诞生｜AI 历史③
title.en: AI History (Part 3): The Birth of a New Term, 'Artificial Intelligence'

summary.zh: 财新“AI 历史”系列第三篇聚焦“人工智能”这一术语的由来。文章梳理该词如何被提出并逐步固定为行业通用名称。
summary.en: The third installment of Caixin's AI history series examines the origins of the term 'artificial intelligence.' It traces how the phrase was coined and gradually became the standard name for the field.

reports.title: 人工智能，一个新词的诞生｜AI 历史③ - 财新

title.zh: 律师称伊朗当局鞭刑未戴头巾演出的歌手
title.en: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say

summary.zh: 据报道，歌手帕拉斯图·艾哈迈迪及三名乐手和一名制作人在库姆被处以74鞭。律师称此举与其未戴头巾演出有关。
summary.en: Lawyers say Iranian authorities flogged singer Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer with 74 lashes in Qom after a performance without a hijab.

reports.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say

title.zh: 国际象棋焦点回归棋盘：古克什迎战辛达罗夫卫冕世界冠军
title.en: Chess-Focus returns to the board as Gukesh defends world title against Sindarov - Reuters

summary.zh: 国际象棋世界冠军古克什将与辛达罗夫展开卫冕战，赛事焦点重新回到棋盘。路透社报道了这场世界冠军对决。
summary.en: World champion Gukesh defends his title against Sindarov, returning chess attention to the board, Reuters reports.

reports.title: Chess-Focus returns to the board as Gukesh defends world title against Sindarov - Reuters

title.zh: 吉赛尔·佩利科特称裸照被发给媒体用于宣传书籍后感到“受辱”
title.en: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book

summary.zh: 出版商为宣传一本关于强制控制的文集，将佩利科特的裸照发给媒体，她表示感到受辱。出版商就这一“不幸且不当的沟通”道歉。
summary.en: Gisèle Pelicot said she felt “humiliated” after nude photos were sent to media to promote a book on coercive control; the publisher apologised for an “unfortunate and inappropriate communication.”

reports.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book

title.zh: 美股Anthropic跌近2%
title.en: Anthropic Falls Nearly 2% on US Markets

summary.zh: 据第一财经报道，美股市场中Anthropic相关标的价格下跌近2%。报道未披露更多细节及具体原因。
summary.en: Anthropic-linked shares fell nearly 2% in US trading, according to Yicai. The report gave no further details or reasons for the decline.

reports.title: 美股Anthropic跌近2% - 第一财经

title.zh: “男性圈层”会如何影响西班牙大选
title.en: How the manosphere could swing Spain’s election

summary.zh: 文章关注西班牙大选前出现的一个新因素：网络“男性圈层”对年轻男性的影响力。作者提供的数据显示，愤怒的年轻男性选民可能改变选举结果。这意味着性别议题正从舆论讨论走向投票，也可能对欧洲其他国家的政治产生影响，因此值得关注。
summary.en: This piece examines a new variable in Spain’s election: the online “manosphere” and its pull on young men. The authors’ data suggest angry young male voters could tip the outcome. It is worth reading for how gender politics is moving from social media into the ballot box, and what that may signal for Europe.

title.zh: “男性圈层”如何利用男性不安全感获利
title.en: How the manosphere cashes in on male insecurity

summary.zh: 文章揭示了争议性网红背后的商业链条：一系列令人不安的赞助合作正围绕男性焦虑获利。作者梳理了这些交易如何把由情绪带动的流量转化为收入。看清这套变现机制，才能理解此类内容的激励结构，而不是只把它当成网络噪音。
summary.en: The article looks behind controversial influencers to a web of troubling sponsorship deals that profit from male insecurity. It traces how anxiety-driven audiences are turned into revenue. Understanding this business model matters: it explains the incentives behind such content and why it is more than online noise.

title.zh: 洪水、大风和降雨可能扰乱美国感恩节假期出行
title.en: Thanksgiving holiday travel could be disrupted by floods, winds and rain

summary.zh: 报道提示，感恩节假期前后恶劣天气将影响美国公路与机场。洪水、强风与降雨可能造成航班延误和道路受阻。对计划出行的人来说，及时掌握天气与交通预警，是判断是否需要改签或绕行的关键。
summary.en: Wild weather is expected to hit roads and airports across the country during the Thanksgiving travel period. Floods, high winds and rain could cause delays and closures. For anyone travelling, it is a practical read on when to check forecasts and consider changing plans.

title.zh: 究竟是什么推动了埃博拉疫情暴发？
title.en: What’s really driving the Ebola outbreak?

summary.zh: 疫苗试验正在进行，但专家指出这场危机远不是仅靠医学手段就能解决。文章追问疫情背后的深层驱动因素，涉及公共卫生体系与社区信任等问题。理解这些非医学因素，是判断防控措施能否奏效的关键。
summary.en: Vaccine trials are underway, but experts argue the crisis needs far more than a medical fix. The piece asks what is really driving the outbreak, pointing to factors beyond the clinical response. It is worth reading because containment depends as much on those underlying conditions as on any vaccine.
